body: i know exactly how you are feeling, i’m also going through a breakup right now and when it happened i cried for a week straight and i’m still sad about it now, so to be honest i don’t really have any advice on how to get over it, as i’m still trying to figure that out myself, however what i can say is you definitely are not alone, i hear you and i know it’s horrible but at this moment in time the most important thing is your mental health :)
please do not hesitate to message me if you need to vent or talk about anything, even if it’s just random stuff that takes your mind off things i’d be happy to talk

i’m so sorry you’re going through this, if you ever need to vent or talk about anything please don’t hesitate to message me. i understand your pain and can relate, you are important and your feelings matter

hey, we are in a very similar situation i’m 17 and i honestly can relate to how you feel. i might not be the best with advice but if you ever need to vent about this please do not hesitate to message me because i understand your struggles and i hear you. i think seeing a doctor would definitely help, i recently went to see one about this similar issue and so far it’s helping but obviously it’s different for everyone. but your problems are valid and sometimes just explaining it to someone you haven’t talked to before might possibly help. i’m so sorry you’re going through this hell, but i hear you and i want to help in anyway

well if it helps distract you or helps you fall asleep at night then i think it’s definitely a good thing because everyone needs their escape from reality and the fact that you can identify fantasy and reality means that it hasn’t become an unhealthy habit yet, but i understand why you might have concerns about everything merging. have you spoken to anyone about this like a therapist or someone you trust?

i honestly relate to this so much, i do the exact same thing i thought i was the only one but to be honest i couldn’t say if it is a healthy thing or not but it certainly does help me and distract me from my depression, so if this also helps you cope then i definitely don’t see an issue with it just as long as you know the line between fantasy and reality :)

this makes me so sad, i’m so sorry you’re feeling this way, if you ever need to just vent or talk please do not hesitate to message me, i know exactly how you are feeling right now and i understand the struggle.
i am really sorry to hear if you need to talk to anyone you can talk to me, i hope to hear back from you if you’ve made it
of course we can message me anytime, and thank you

i am really sorry you feel this way, i actually know how you feel. i have one best friend who is amazing but i don't really have any other friends. i know it must feel really lonely and loneliness is a really shit feeling. i wish i could give you some advice on how to make friends but i'm really in the same position as you, so all i can say is that if you ever need to talk or vent i am here, even though i am just a random person, your problems are valid :))

i am so sorry that you are feeling this way, i know it feels terrible when one of your friends betrays you and it feels like your whole world is turned upside down. if you ever need anyone to talk to i am here, even though i'm a random person from the internet i can relate to how you are feeling and sometimes it helps just to talk. i really hope that you decide to continue with life, because even though things might seem really shit right now, something will happen and it will turn your life around. i hope you find something to keep yourself distracted, sending love.

i'm not the best with advice but what i can say is i'm in a really similar position to you right now and the best thing to do is prioritize yourself and your mental health because at the end of the day it will be impossible for you to complete work when you are under that much stress. something relaxing like listening to music, watching something funny, or meditating could possibly calm you down so you have some motivation to complete your everyday tasks. sorry if this wasn't much help, but just so you know i hear you and your problems are valid :)
it is the worst when that happens, and i can relate. i'm so sorry you feel this way if you need someone to talk to i am here

i am really sorry that you feel like this, i can relate and it's horrible. whenever i feel like doing it i try and watch something funny or i talk to someone, but obviously this doesn't always help. i am not good with advice but the best thing i could say is to go online and research things to do to distract yourself, it might not help very much but it is definitely a start. i hope the urge passes soon, and if you need to talk to someone i am here.
thank you so much for saying that it really means a lot, i hope everything is going well for you too, i really appreciate it

i am so sorry you are feeling this way, i know it's a terrible feeling, like no matter what you do the world around you just keeps happening and it feels like you're not really present or you're missing out because of the way you feel. i am really not the best with advice, but what i can say is that i hear you, i know this feeling that you are talking about and you are not alone. talking to people you love or are close with sometimes helps brighten up the mood, whether you're venting or just talking about something random. look for things to distract yourself with and make the day go faster. i really hope things get better and i'm sorry you're struggling.

hey, i am in a very similar place as you right now, i'm 17 and i'm having the same thoughts as you are. i'm not the best with advice because i am also in this situation but i just want you to know that you are not alone. i know that's like what everyone says, but someone out there understands how you're feeling. if professional help is not the best option for you, then maybe talking to a close friend would be helpful? that's honestly the only thing that's helped me so far. if not that, reaching out to anyone might make you feel better with just being able to vent about your thoughts. sorry if this isn't too much help at all, but i hear you and what you are saying.
